target_definition: longest METR 50% task time horizon among models released by each month, per METR suite version

split.rule: last 20% of origins scorable at h=12 (min 4); selection pairs purged when their outcome period is after the holdout's first observed period

selection_rule: lowest selection MAE (pp); simplest within 2% of best
history_warning: few real vintages (METR in Epoch data since 2025-06; v1.1 since 2026-03); most backtest origins are reconstructed

3.rule: raw or temperature-calibrated chances, whichever had the lower selection log loss; then shrunk 25% to the base rate unless their selection Brier beat both a 1/3 guess and the base rate on >= 10 cases

6.rule: raw or temperature-calibrated chances, whichever had the lower selection log loss; then shrunk 25% to the base rate unless their selection Brier beat both a 1/3 guess and the base rate on >= 10 cases

12.rule: raw or temperature-calibrated chances, whichever had the lower selection log loss; then shrunk 25% to the base rate unless their selection Brier beat both a 1/3 guess and the base rate on >= 10 cases

bootstrap.comparison: pace chances minus base rate, Brier
pace chances minus base rate, Brier
pace chances minus base rate, Brier

backtest.brier_definition: sum over classes of (probability - outcome)^2, averaged: 0 perfect, 2 worst; a 1/3 guess scores 0.67 for three classes; 0.5 for a yes/no 50/50 guess
backtest.note: Most origins are reconstructed (later measurements of models released by then), so scores are approximate; real point-in-time origins exist only from Jun 2025. Neighbouring forecasts overlap in time: see the non-overlapping and bootstrap results.

robust_local_trend.reason: interval score 1.18 x the damped trend's (> 1.1)

jump_process.reason: interval score 1.01 x the damped trend's (<= 1.1)

record_jump.reason: interval score 1.10 x the damped trend's (<= 1.1)

logit_compute_growth_12m.reason: lower log loss in >= 90% of resamples

logit_lab_releases_3m.reason: lower log loss in >= 90% of resamples

data.source: METR time horizons (Time Horizon 1.1 current; 1.0 legacy), as published in Epoch AI's benchmark data (monthly Wayback captures = point-in-time vintages)
